body:
## Complete Tool, Extension, Command & Skill Inventory

### 1. Core pi Tools (bundled with pi-coding-agent v0.81.1)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **read** | Read file contents (text + images). Offset/limit for large files. |
| **bash** | Execute bash commands. Timeout support. Output truncated to 2000 lines/50KB. |
| **todo** | Task list tracking — create, update, list, get, delete, clear. 4-state: pending/in_progress/completed/deleted. |
| **telegram_attach** | Queue local files to send with next Telegram reply. |
| **fusion** | Multi-model deliberation — panel of authed models + judge. For research, critique, comparisons. |
| **questionnaire** | Ask user one+ questions. Tab interface for multi-question. 180s timeout. |

### 2. Picode Tools (from picode extension)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **picode_status** | Read own state + journal (role, state, barriers, obligations, owed replies, journal entries). |
| **picode_list** | List all known threads in workspace with state/role. |
| **picode_journal** | Read another picode's journal without messaging. |
| **picode_send** | Send messages to picodes. expects=true for request, re=id to reply, urgency, deliverAfterSeconds, wait mode. |
| **picode_wait** | Wait for replies to outstanding requests. mode="all"/"any", optional self-message on resolution. |
| **picode_suspend** | Mark self On Hold (cooperative). Inbox queues until resume. |
| **picode_resume** | Resume from On Hold back to Open. Drains queued inbox. |
| **picode_purge** | Delete stale picode data dirs (stopped or stale >60s, no pending debts). force flag. |
| **picode_panes** | Survey all Herdr panes — status, position, role. Workspace/status filter. |
| **spawn_worker** | Split pane, name it, launch pi with model/theme, wait for idle. Reuses existing panes. |
| **cleanup_panes** | Close stale worker panes (not working/idle). dry_run option. |
| **picode_run** | Run shell command in disposable pane. Blocking (returns output+exit code) or non-blocking (returns pane_id). |

### 3. Web Access Tools (pi-web-access v0.10.7)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **web_search** | Search via Perplexity, Exa, or Gemini. Multi-query with 2-4 varied angles. Auto-curator browser UI. |
| **fetch_content** | Extract readable content from URLs, YouTube, GitHub repos, local videos. Frame extraction. |
| **get_search_content** | Retrieve full stored content from prior web_search/fetch_content by responseId + selectors. |
| **code_search** | Code examples/docs from GitHub, Stack Overflow, official docs. API usage, library examples. |

### 4. Hypa Tools (@hypabolic/pi-hypa v0.1.11)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **hypa_shell** | Run shell commands through Hypa compression. |
| **hypa_read** | Read file through Hypa compression. |
| **hypa_grep** | Ripgrep search through Hypa compression. |
| **hypa_find** | Find files through Hypa compression. |
| **hypa_ls** | List directory through Hypa compression. |
| **hypa_mcp_proxy** | MCP proxy bridge for external tools. |

### 5. Picode Slash Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **/picode-status** | Show own state + last 12 journal entries |
| **/picode-journal** | View/trim/clear/compact journal: status\|tail N\|trim N\|clear\|compact |
| **/picode-list** | List all threads in workspace |
| **/picode-send** | Send note to picode: /picode-send <to> <body...> |
| **/picode-suspend** | Mark self On Hold: /picode-suspend [reason] |
| **/picode-resume** | Resume from On Hold back to Open |
| **/picode-reset** | Clear all obligations/owed/barriers across threads (--force for self) |
| **/picode-models** | Configure worker models (interactive or positional: role model) |

| **/windsurf-logout** | pi-windsurf | Log out Windsurf session |

| **/git-footer-visibility** | git-footer-status | Toggle footer visibility |
| **/git-footer-pi-debug** | git-footer-status | Debug pi extension info |
| **/websearch** | pi-web-access | Web search controls |
| **/curator** | pi-web-access | Curator dashboard |
| **/google-account** | pi-web-access | Google account status |
| **/search** | pi-web-access | Quick search alias |
| **/init** | custom extension | Init something |

### 8. Skills Available

| Skill | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| **librarian** | pi-web-access | Open-source library research with GitHub permalinks |
| **herdr** | picode/skills | Terminal multiplexer control for agents |
| **fromai** | ~/.pi/agent/skills | Offload isolated code tasks to human |
| **land-the-plane** | ~/.pi/agent/skills | End-of-session wrap-up protocol |
| **lavish** | ~/.pi/agent/skills | Rich HTML artifact generation (lavish-axi CLI) |

### 9. Bundled Themes (7)
